description: This Java source file defines the ModelMenuItem class, which models a <menu-item> XML element within the OFBiz framework. It encapsulates properties and behaviors related to menu items, including nested menu items, links, conditions, actions, and rendering logic. The class is designed to be immutable and thread-safe, representing read-only configuration data for dynamic menu structures.

classes.name: ModelMenuItem
classes.description: Represents a <menu-item> element, encapsulating its attributes, child menu items, link, condition, and actions. Provides immutability and methods to access properties, evaluate rendering conditions, and render the menu item.

classes.name: ModelMenuItem.MenuLink
classes.description: Inner class that models a link associated with a menu item, handling URL parameters, target, and rendering capabilities.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the list of actions associated with the menu item.

methods.name: getAlign
methods.description: Returns the alignment setting, inherited from parent if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getAlignStyle
methods.description: Returns the alignment style, inherited from parent if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getAssociatedContentId
methods.description: Returns the expandable string representing the associated content ID.

methods.name: getAssociatedContentId
methods.description: Returns the expanded associated content ID string given a context.

methods.name: getCellWidth
methods.description: Returns the cell width attribute, falling back to default if unset.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Returns the condition object used to evaluate if the menu item should be rendered.

methods.name: getDisabledTitleStyle
methods.description: Returns the style for disabled titles, inherited if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getDisableIfEmpty
methods.description: Returns the 'disable-if-empty' attribute value.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the entity name, inherited from parent if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getHideIfSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the menu item should be hidden if selected.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns the MenuLink object associated with this menu item.

methods.name: getMenuItemList
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of child menu items.

methods.name: getModelMenu
methods.description: Returns the ModelMenu object this item belongs to.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the override name if set, otherwise the original name.

methods.name: getOverrideName
methods.description: Returns the override name.

methods.name: getParentMenuItem
methods.description: Returns the parent menu item, if any.

methods.name: getParentPortalPageId
methods.description: Returns the expandable string for parent portal page ID.

methods.name: getParentPortalPageId
methods.description: Returns the expanded parent portal page ID given a context.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Returns the positional index of the menu item, defaults to 1 if unset.

methods.name: getSelectedStyle
methods.description: Returns the style for selected items, inherited if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getSubMenu
methods.description: Returns the sub-menu attribute.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander for the title.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the expanded title string given a context.

methods.name: getTitleStyle
methods.description: Returns the style for the title, inherited if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getTooltip
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander for the tooltip.

methods.name: getTooltip
methods.description: Returns the expanded tooltip string given a context.

methods.name: getTooltipStyle
methods.description: Returns the style for tooltip, inherited if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getWidgetStyle
methods.description: Returns the style for the widget, inherited if not explicitly set.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Determines if the menu item is currently selected based on context.

methods.name: mergeOverrideModelMenuItem
methods.description: Merges the current menu item with an override, returning a new immutable instance.

methods.name: renderMenuItemString
methods.description: Renders the menu item as a string using a renderer, considering portal page expansions.

methods.name: shouldBeRendered
methods.description: Evaluates the condition for rendering based on the context.
